Name: A skeleton in a Fedora - Hats for monsters
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
[center][img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/798217808634839050/1047510024840302642/m-lady.png[/img][/center]

This mod is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. It adds hats for monsters. This is totally randomized and monsters will now have a unique style!

Current version includes hats for:
- Bugs (regular, armored & dangerous variants)
- Slimes
- Big Slimes
- Skeletons (regular & dangerous variants)
- Mummies (regular & dangerous variants)

[i][b]A note about slimes: [/b][/i]the color of the slimes is managed internally by the game, so the hats will automatically be the same color as the slimes.

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
